root_causes.description: The checkout container was killed for a definition change ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted') and the pod cannot become ready because the sandbox pause image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull (DeadlineExceeded -> ErrImagePull -> ImagePullBackOff). The pod is stuck NotReady, collapsing checkout traffic to near-zero with 100% of remaining requests erroring and no container logs being emitted.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: checkout container killed and restart attempted 2 times in window
evidence.expected_baseline: no Killing/restart events during steady-state operation

evidence.observed_value: ImagePullBackOff x3, ErrImagePull x4, Back-off pulling image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest x3, DeadlineExceeded pull failures x4
evidence.expected_baseline: pause image already cached/pullable; pod reaches Ready state
cpu_usage > 0.1 cores under normal checkout load

evidence.observed_value: request_rate mean=0.038, max=0.057 req/s; error_rate identical (mean=0.038, max=0.057) = 100% of requests failing
no logs found — container not running to emit logs
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout emits logs continuously under normal operation

root_causes.description: With checkout NotReady, upstream callers (frontend, accounting, fraud-detection per topology) experience dependency failures on checkout calls, explaining the 100% error rate on the residual checkout traffic.

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.038, max=0.057 — equals total request rate exactly, all checkout calls failing

root_causes.description: Secondary interpretation: the residual checkout requests abort with errors, but the near-zero request rate, zero CPU, and absent logs indicate the pod is down rather than actively rejecting requests, making pod_crash the primary classification.

evidence.observed_value: error_rate max=0.057 with request_rate max=0.057 (all calls error)

remediation_steps: Fix the image pull failure for gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest: verify node egress/registry connectivity, configure imagePullSecrets or a registry mirror, or pre-pull/cache the pause image on the otel-demo worker nodes.

Review the checkout container definition change that triggered the 'Killing ... will be restarted' event; roll back the rollout (kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout -n otel-demo) if the change is faulty.
Once the image pulls successfully, force a pod restart (kubectl rollout restart deployment/checkout -n otel-demo) and verify the pod reaches Ready with kubectl get pods -n otel-demo.
Monitor checkout request_rate/error_rate and CPU usage to confirm traffic recovery, and add a readiness gate/alert on ImagePullBackOff to catch this failure mode earlier.
